headline: REDEMPLO revenue ramp continues, losses widen on R&D spend
summary_short: Arrowhead's revenue rose 171% y/y and 2.1% q/q to $75.3M on REDEMPLO's continued U.S. launch, while net loss widened 10.9% y/y to $194.3M (-$1.36 diluted EPS) as R&D and SG&A spending increased.
summary_long: Revenue grew 171% y/y and 2.1% q/q to $75.3M as REDEMPLO's U.S. launch continued to build momentum — prescription volume roughly doubled q/q, with over 400 unique prescribers now on board — plus new EC and Australian TGA marketing authorizations. R&D expense rose to $198.2M and SG&A to $47.1M; operating loss widened 20.4% q/q (roughly flat y/y, -2.7%) to $170.1M. Net loss widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M ($1.36 diluted loss per share), partly reflecting a $15.4M income allocation to noncontrolling interest this quarter versus a $3.4M loss allocation a year ago. Stockholders' equity fell 24.2% q/q to $465.5M. No forward financial guidance was given in this release.
